notes.title: Recollections to be Free
notes.content: Midnight Renegade: Recollections will be free on August 24th. Thank you to all of you who decided it was worth the buy. For those of you looking for a refund, the most you can do is request a refund from Steam if it's still available through their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds/]refund policy[/url]. Still, anyone who has a save file before August 1st, 2022, will be given a little reward for showing their support. It's nothing much, but it's there.
